name: Camera Hikvision 6-inch 23x Anti-corrosion Network Speed Dome – DS-2DT6223-AELY
summary: 316L stainless steel enclosure, protecting cameras to be used in corrosive environments, providing reliability and longevity compared to standard cameras A built-in heater allows for start-up in ultra-low temperatures to -40℃ IP67/IK10: water resistant and vandal proof, preventing water ingress for outdoor use DarkFighter technology enables the capture of high quality color images in even the dimmest lighting environments PTZ: pan-tilt-zoom ability allows the camera to move to view zones of interest Up to 23X zoom: zoom to examine subjects of interest within expansive scenes
